==Notes==
*Can be combined with [[Life]] or [[Signet of Spirits]] for a larger healing burst.
*Healing occurs before spirits are destroyed.
**Synergizes very well with [[Lacerate]], to trigger bleeding on foes but not allies.
**Destroying the spirit of [[Restoration]] will resurrect allies but they will not get the healing.
*Healing is caused by the caster and will trigger hexes like [[Scourge Healing]].
*Be careful using this if you have more than one Ritualist in your party. While the healing will be greater, you may destroy their build by killing important spirits.

{{Bug|The plain text description says "nearby '''allies''''" spirits, instead of "nearby '''allied''' spirits". The skill works according to the concise description.}}
